runtime.note: EXT_texture_webp is USED, not REQUIRED - a JPEG fallback image is embedded, so any conformant glTF 2.0 loader opens this file without extension support. No Draco, no Meshopt, no KTX2.

mesh.note: Source was already 11,271 triangles - inside the 6k-15k target band for a normal mob - and is a single mesh with a single material. No decimation, no mesh merging and no silhouette change were needed.

material.name: mutant_M
material.baseColorTexture: embedded 512x512 (WebP q86 primary, JPEG q86 fallback)
material.normalMapDecision: Dropped. Measured A/B: at mid camera distance only 0.86% of rendered pixels differ by more than 20/765; close up 3.5-4.8%. The source diffuse already has muscle shading and AO baked in, so the normal map adds almost nothing at 2.5D distance. Keeping a 256 normal map would cost +57.3 KB (860.7 KB total).

texture.final: Mutant_diffuse -> 512x512 WebP 77.9 KB (+ JPEG fallback 86.4 KB); normal map not shipped
texture.uvRange: [0.003, 0.997] - single UV set, no atlas packing needed

skeleton.namingNote: Original Mixamo names kept verbatim, prefix included. 'Mutant' is a plain identity transform root; 'Mutant_Mesh' holds the skinned mesh; 'mixamorig:Hips' is the skeleton root.

attachmentNodes.mixamorig:LeftHand: present as a NODE but not a skin joint - it carries zero skin weight in the source (the whole left claw is skinned to LeftForeArm). Kept as a static attachment / debug-reach point.
attachmentNodes.mixamorig:HeadTop_End: static node kept as an over-head anchor (health bar, damage numbers, aggro marker).

skeleton.removalProof: Every removed bone carries exactly zero skin weight AND deviates 0.000 deg / 0.0000 cm from its bind local transform across all 8 selected clips. The reduction is therefore mathematically lossless: measured skinning deviation is 0.0000 cm.
skeleton.fingersKept: All 9 animated right-hand finger bones (Index1-3, Pinky1-3, Thumb1-3) were KEPT. They rotate up to 85 deg across the selected clips and the right fist is the punch striking surface, so merging them was rejected.
skeleton.secondaryBones: The rig has no cloth, armour, belly, spike or appendage bones - it is a plain 37-bone mixamorig humanoid skeleton with a partial right hand.

animations.name: 01_IDLE
animations.loopNote: loops; measured seam 0.47 cm / 0.94 deg. 14.23 s of non-repeating motion - a single long cycle, no shorter internal loop exists (verified).

animations.name: 02_IDLE_BREATHE
animations.loopNote: loops; measured seam 0.00 cm / 0.00 deg (mathematically exact).

animations.name: 05_ATTACK_SWIPE

timing.strikingLimb: left claw (the whole left forearm+claw is driven by mixamorig:LeftForeArm; mixamorig:LeftHand carries no skin weight in the source)
timing.note: Single strike, not a combo. 0.000-0.567 s the creature settles, 0.567-1.100 s the left claw is drawn back to 1.19 m BEHIND the hips, 1.100-1.300 s it whips forward, contact at frame 39. The swing crosses the front in 3 frames, so use the [37,40] window for hit detection rather than a single instant. The right arm counter-rotates during the swing; it never exceeds 6 m/s before frame 37 and does not strike.

animations.suggestedRole: heavy / long-range attack: 2.67 s cycle, hit at 49% of the clip, 1.53 m reach

animations.name: 06_ATTACK_PUNCH

timing.strikingLimb: right fist (mixamorig:RightHand plus its 3 finger chains)
timing.note: Straight right punch. Fist pulls back over frames 0-5, extends explosively 6-8, contact at frame 8, retracts from frame 10. Peak hand speed is at frame 9, one frame after maximum extension.

animations.suggestedRole: basic / fast attack: 1.10 s cycle, hit at 24% of the clip, 0.85 m reach

animations.name: 07_ROAR
animations.loopNote: one-shot; source first and last pose differ by 15.1 deg so it must NOT be looped. LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished, or blend back to 01_IDLE.
animations.usage: visual / state only - produces no gameplay damage. Peak pose (max arm spread + head raised) at 1.40 s; a 0.0-2.2 s sub-range works as a short aggro intro.

animations.name: 08_DEATH
animations.loopNote: one-shot; MUST use LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished so the corpse holds the final pose. First/last pose differ by 91.2 deg.
animations.finalPose: lies flat on its back; mesh top 0.434 m above ground

optionalClips.name: OPTIONAL_FLEX
optionalClips.status: NOT included in V1 runtime GLB
optionalClips.evaluation: Reads clearly as a taunt / flex: the creature hunches forward and tenses at ~2.3 s, arm spread swings 0.76-1.03 m. Loops cleanly (0.69 deg seam) and has zero root motion. Good candidate for elite intro / boss idle special / taunt. Costs about 35 KB if added later.

missingClips.name: HIT_REACT
missingClips.note: There is no hit / damage reaction animation anywhere in Creature Pack (2). All 19 animation files were checked by content, not just by name: 3 idles, walk, run, 5 turns, 4 jump/jump-attack, swipe, punch, roar, dying, flexing muscles. None is a flinch or a stagger. No clip was renamed to fill the gap. Download a real hit reaction from Mixamo before P2.2.

excludedSources.reason: turn animations not needed - mob visual root is rotated directly through Three.js
no jump, no dodge and no vertical combat locomotion in Project Legacy

third idle - runtime is capped at 2. It is the most animated of the three (9.49 deg mean amplitude) but has the worst loop seam by far: 2.09 cm / 6.14 deg vertex pop at the loop point, versus 0.47 cm for the chosen main idle and 0.00 cm for breathing idle. Kept out on measured loop quality, not on style.
marked OPTIONAL per brief - see optionalClips

knownIssues: 08_DEATH dips 0.0705 m below Y=0 during the fall. This comes from the Mixamo source clip, not from this pipeline. Offset the corpse up by ~7 cm or disable ground collision in the death state.
08_DEATH keeps its authored 0.87 m backward displacement (rootMotionRemoved=false) - a backward fall is real body motion, not locomotion. Gameplay position stays with MobAi / MobSlotSystem.
03_WALK has a 1.40 cm loop seam (04_RUN is 0.22 cm). Invisible with a short crossfade, but do not hard-cut walk at the loop point.

01_IDLE is 14.23 s and costs 107 KB, 13% of the whole file. It is a single non-repeating cycle - there is no shorter clean sub-loop (verified frame by frame). Swap to mutant idle (2) at 5.3 s if you need the space, accepting its 2.09 cm seam.
